Shop facts: The advertised price on a results card is the price of that listing's cheapest option that can be bought, so it is a lower bound on the prices of its buyable options. The price a listing shows before a size is chosen is its cheapest option that can be bought, not necessarily the size asked about. A size's price is shown after that size is chosen and the page is read again; the reply to choosing an option does not show the new price. An option can be absent from the menu, present but unavailable, or available to buy. An unavailable option is disabled or greyed out and cannot be chosen from the menu, so it has no selectable price.
A size's label in the menu can carry promotional or stock text; the price is the one shown after the size is chosen, and a label's claim is not a checked fact.
